scenarios.name: Outgoing
scenarios.procedure: Call an agreed controlled endpoint; answer remotely; confirm both directions of audio; end locally, then repeat with remote hangup.
scenarios.passObservations: Correct destination/provider and one call; truthful connecting/active/ended state; both participants confirm media; end removes active media and restores ended actions.
scenarios.reason: Not exercised in a separately recorded practical session.

scenarios.name: Incoming / decline
scenarios.procedure: Call from the controlled endpoint; answer once, then repeat and decline.
scenarios.passObservations: Correct identity/account and configured ringtone; Answer/Decline work; answered audio works both ways; decline leaves no call or continuing ringtone.
scenarios.reason: Not exercised in a separately recorded practical session.

scenarios.name: Mute / hold
scenarios.procedure: Mute/unmute and hold/resume a controlled call; separately end while held.
scenarios.passObservations: Remote observations agree with controls; resume restores media; end while held finishes normally.
scenarios.reason: Not exercised in a separately recorded practical session.

scenarios.name: Transfer
scenarios.procedure: Exercise each transfer mode actually offered, using agreed endpoints; separately cancel the sheet.
scenarios.passObservations: Intended recipient receives transfer; no duplicate media; expected final state; cancellation leaves original call usable. Record provider rejection separately.

scenarios.name: DTMF
scenarios.procedure: Send 0–9, *, # and each supported A–D/R input through keypad and keyboard to a controlled receiver.
scenarios.passObservations: Receiver confirms the exact sequence once per input; ordinary text entry elsewhere emits no tones. Record provider support per variant.
scenarios.reason: Not exercised in a separately recorded practical session.

scenarios.name: Selected route
scenarios.procedure: Compare accepted current route/help with a controlled outgoing call.
scenarios.passObservations: Actual provider/destination matches the admitted plan; accurate provider help; no unexpected fallback.
scenarios.reason: Not exercised in a separately recorded practical session.

scenarios.name: Waiting cancellation
scenarios.procedure: Make the selected test provider unavailable; enqueue one request, cancel it, then restore availability.
scenarios.passObservations: Waiting accurately identifies the request; cancellation removes it; restoration produces no delayed call.
scenarios.reason: Not exercised in a separately recorded practical session.

scenarios.name: Pending request ownership
scenarios.procedure: Queue a controlled request, change its route or remove/disable its account, then restore availability.
scenarios.passObservations: No unexpected reroute or stale-account call; compare immutable admitted request/account validation with the recorded expected policy before execution.
scenarios.reason: Not exercised in a separately recorded practical session.

scenarios.name: Actual capture / export
scenarios.procedure: With participant consent, record known short local/remote phrases; stop/end and export each offered format under acceptance.
scenarios.passObservations: Both expected channels and interval captured; output plays with correct filename/format; successful export cleans only its own completed raw job.
scenarios.reason: Not exercised in a separately recorded practical session.

scenarios.name: Failed export / retry
scenarios.procedure: In an isolated profile, export synthetic capture to deliberately unwritable scratch storage; defer, reopen, then Retry/Save Elsewhere.
scenarios.passObservations: Visible failure; original tracks retained; recoverable job rediscovered; retry produces usable audio; no silent overwrite or premature deletion.
scenarios.reason: Not exercised in a separately recorded practical session.

scenarios.name: Recovery / termination
scenarios.procedure: With an isolated failed job, exercise Stay Open and Keep Files and Quit separately; reopen.
scenarios.passObservations: Stay Open cancels quit; keeping files preserves the job; reopen discovers it; retry succeeds.
scenarios.reason: Not exercised in a separately recorded practical session.

scenarios.name: Audio-loss segments

scenarios.passObservations: Original segment finalises; no recording claimed during loss; successful retry may start a separately named segment; hangup remains possible.
